title: Cube patterns
summary: Hearts and pixel figures on a cube, made for fun with my own move sequences.
galleryIntro: Hearts and little pixel figures, made with move sequences I worked out on large twisty cubes.
body: I work out my own move sequences on large twisty cubes, using commutators to rearrange small groups of pieces, then combining the sequences to make hearts and little pixel figures. The puzzle is to build up the picture without undoing the parts already in place. Finding the moves is part of the enjoyment.
